name: Sakuma Sakuya
source:
Leader of the Spring Troupe. 

"Although he has loved dramas ever since he was little, he still needs more experience and technique. Despite this, he is a hard worker who puts his all into practice. His familial situation at home is a little complicated, so he auditioned after he heard about recruitment for live-in actor troupe members. He was the first member to join the brand new MANKAI Company."

[From the [url=https://yaycupcake.com/a3/index.php?title=Sakuya_Sakuma]A3! Wiki[/url]]
